title: Virginia county summer precipitation and corn grain yield

climate.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
climate.dataset: Monthly U.S. Climate Divisional Database (nClimDiv), county precipitation
climate.measurement: Area-weighted county precipitation estimated from gridded station data, inches.
climate.selection: Original full-year text records for NOAA state 44 and calendar years 2000 through 2024, inclusive.
climate.calculation: June, July and August each contribute the published monthly accumulation. The summer total requires all three months. NOAA precipitation sentinel -9.99 is missing.

crop.dataset: Quick Stats annual county survey estimates

selection.SHORT_DESC: CORN, GRAIN - YIELD, MEASURED IN BU / ACRE

source.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats crops public bulk snapshot,30October2026

crop.preservation: The CSV carries original values, row numbers, survey status, load times and coefficients of variation. A literal backslash and zero in the CV field represents an original NUL (unavailable). Empty CV is retained as empty. Published zero yield is a numeric value.

geography.join: Census state 51 and the three-digit county code match the USDA ANSI fields. NOAA state 44 is Virginia and NOAA specifies that its three-digit county field is county FIPS. Independent cities retain their own Census codes.
geography.limits: The 2020 list fixes the selectable geographic units. Source-year boundaries may vary. No adjustment for historical boundary changes or reassignment of discontinued localities is made.

missingness: Annual rows cover every listed place. Missing USDA rows describe the retained survey series only. No estimates are interpolated. County-level seasonal associations are descriptive.
